name: EPIC 202916160
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 16.7 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 202916160 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.693968 (16th-84th percentiles 15.733424-18.115992), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 202916160 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.863541 (16th-84th percentiles 0.754187-1.036484), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 202916160: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4707.468 +/- 102 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 202916160 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2989.804688 (16th-84th percentiles 2849.101562-3156.09375), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 1.08 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,990 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.86 solar masses and 16.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,707 K at its surface.
